Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out to the middle. Danushka Gunathilaka and Pathum Nissanka are the openers for Sri Lanka. Jhye Richardson to start with the ball. Here we go...
... The Chase...

Right then! Not much at stake but Sri Lanka will look for a win and their batters can bat without thinking much for the first time in this series. Australia will love to make it 3-0 though. Stay tuned for the second essay.

It is the same story for Sri Lanka, the spinners did an impressive job but were not well supported by the seamers. They should have restricted Australia near 140 after impressive bowling from Wanindu Hasaranga and Maheesh Theekshana in the middle phase but all the good work was washed away when the pace was offered once again. Now, it is time for the batters to do the job and chase it down.

Australia have done really well to post a fighting total after losing their way in the middle phase. After opting to bat, the visitors were off to a good start courtesy of David Warner and Aaron Finch but once the spinners were introduced, the Aussies lost their plot as wickets fall in quick succession but the run rate floated around 8 the whole time and their innings was brought back on the track by a quick cameo from Marcus Stoinis and a good finish from Steven Smith and Matthew Wade has helped them reach a defendable total.
What a finish from Australia! 59 runs from the last 5 overs and they have reached a very good score. It should be enough as this is not an easy pitch to bat on.
Swing and a miss! A slower ball now, full, outside off. Steven Smith looks to sweep this one but he misses and he is undone by the lack of pace. Australia end at 176 for 5!
SIX! Bang! What a shot this is from Steven Smith! A low full toss, wide of off. Steven Smith reaches out to it, opens the face of the bat and smashes it over point for a biggie.

FOUR! Nicely done! Change of angle fo Dushmantha Chameera now! He goes over the wicket, and serves a shortish ball, wide of off. Steven Smith goes hard at it but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary. Australia gets to 170 with that!
Wide! Wide of off again, full in length. This time Steven Smith leaves it alone. Wide given!
Well bowled! Very slow on this occasion, fuller ball, wide of off. Steven Smith shuffles across and tries to hit this on the leg side but he misses.
Another low full toss, darting it on the pads. Matthew Wade looks to flick this on the leg side, but he gets a leading edge towards sweeper cover. Single taken!
FOUR! A full toss this time, outside off. Matthew Wade drives it powerfully towards deep cover for a boundary. A four on the first delivery of the final over!
Dushmantha Chameera to bowl the final over.
FOUR! Good end to the over for Australia! A slower ball, full, around off. Steven Smith sweeps it the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg, slower in pace. Matthew Wade knocks it towards mid-on for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! Back of a length, outside off. Matthew Wade punches it off the back foot past the diving fielder at cover for a boundary.
Wide! Chamika Karunaratne errs in line and serves it wide outside of off. Matthew Wade leaves it alone. Kusal Mendis dives to his left and makes a good stop there. Wide called!
Chamika Karunaratne drops it short now, outside off. Steven Smith slaps it without any timing towards mid off and scampers across towards the other end.
Two dots in a row! This one angles in, on a length, on the pads. Steven Smith looks to heave this on the leg side but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Very full, outside off, slower in pace. Steven Smith drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Chamika Karunaratne to bowl the penultimate over.
Flatter, around middle. Steven Smith advances down the pitch and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Bang! A flat six from Smith! A googly, fuller ball, around off. Steven Smith picks up the googly, gets low, and slog sweeps this towards cow corner for a biggie.
Shorter, around middle. Matthew Wade pulls it straight to the fielder at deep mid-wicket.
Tad quicker, full in length, around off. Matthew Wade presses forward and pushes it towards cover.
Shorter now, another googly, around off. Steven Smith pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A googly, full in length, around middle. Steven Smith steps down the track and flicks it toward deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Steven Smith cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Matthew Wade knocks it towards long on for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Smith pulls it to mid-wicket for a single. Not of the middle but will get a single.
This is very full and outside off. Wade carves it to third man for a single.
Tight on middle. Smith tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length and on off, pushed to covers.
Matthew Wade is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Praveen Jayawickrama does have the last laugh! He gets his man! Lovely delivery by him this time. A loopy one, slower through the air, full, around off. Marcus Stoinis shimmies down the track and swings his bat but he misses as the ball spins away from him. Kusal Mendis collects the ball and whips the bails off. Marcus Stoinis departs!
Commentary.Howout: st Kusal Mendis b Praveen Jayawickrama

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! A fuller one, around middle. Marcus Stoinis gets down on his knee and looks to sweep this but he misses. A huge appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger! Marcus Stoinis opts for a review. The replay rolls in and UltraEdge shows there was a slight edge on that. Not out it is!
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Marcus Stoinis lifts it towards long on. The fielder there runs forward, and dives forward, but he fails to reach the ball. The ball goes past him. Two taken!
FOUR! Make that 14 runs off 3 balls! Fuller, slower through the air, around off. Marcus Stoinis slashes it past cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! Another lovely shot! Tad shorter, around off. Marcus Stoinis hangs back, cuts and cuts it last past point for a boundary. 10 runs off two balls.
SIX! KABOOM! A fuller ball, slower through the air, around the leg pole. Marcus Stoinis gets down on his knee and sweeps it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Again there is extra bounce but this is on the slower side, outside off. Stoinis dabs it to third man for a single.
Length ball slanting on middle. Stoinis hits it back to the bowler.
This one shoots off the deck, shorter and outside off. Stoinis leaves it alone. A wide given for height.
Length and on off. Smith wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one this time at 144 clicks, on middle. Stoinis knocks it to point for a single.
Slower one outside off. Smith plays it down to third man for a single.
Length and on top of middle. Stoinis works it to deep point for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera comes back to bowl. He went for 24 runs in his two overs.
Good running! This is really good from Australia as the boundaries are hard to buy right now. Fuller and on middle. Smith clips it down to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Another single as this is hit to long off.
Shorter and outside off. Stoinis cuts it hard and to deep point where the fielder runs to his right and stops it with a dive. Two.
In the air but safe! A loopy ball, on off. Smith backs away and lofts it in the air and to long off where the fielder runs to his right and collects it on a bounce. A single.
Slightly short and outside off. Stoinis slaps it to long off and takes a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Smith knocks it over covers and takes a single.

Ohh..how has that missed the stumps! This is on middle and nicely flighted on the slower side. It lands and spins away. Stoinis looks to defend on the front foot but misses and the ball goes past the off pole.
Nicely flighted, on off. Smith chips it to long on for a single.
On middle, drilled down to long on for one.
FOUR! 100 up for Australia! Welcome boundary! Too full and on middle. Stoinis reverse sweeps it and hits it past short third man for a boundary. Much needed to get back the momentum.
Length and outside off, spinning in. Stoinis strokes it to deep cover for a brace.
Tossed up on middle, swept to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Wanindu Hasaranga (2-0-12-1) comes back into the attack.
Another dot to end the over! Slower again, full and on off. Smith pushes it back to the bowler who parries it to the cover fielder. No run.
Again slower from Praveen! This is full and outside off, pushed to covers.
Slower again, length and outside off. Stoinis works it to deep point for a single.
This is full and around off. Stoinis lifts it wide of long off and the fielder there runs to his left and tumbles to save a couple
Tossed up, slower and outside off. Smith drives it to long off for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Stoinis slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter now, turning in, around middle. Steven Smith flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket. Good over this for Sri Lanka! Two wickets off it!
Pitches it up, around middle. Marcus Stoinis sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Another fuller ball, spinning in, around middle and leg. Steven Smith works it away towards fine leg for a single. Steven Smith is off the mark as well!
Tosses it up, very full, slower through the air. Marcus Stoinis flicks it gently towards square leg for a single. Marcus Stoinis gets off the mark with that.
Marcus Stoinis comes to the crease.

OUT! RUN OUT! Team Hat-Trick! What a turnaround this is from Sri Lanka! Josh Inglis goes for a golden duck. Australia are losing their way here! This is full and on middle. Inglis paddles it and the ball rolls away behind the keeper. Charith Asalanka at first slip, anticipates and moves across quickly to stop it. Meanwhile, there is an adrenaline rush for Inglis who tries to take a run which is not available there. He is sent back and Asalanka scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. Even the keeper had enough time to clip the bails off but he was not required there. Brilliant work from Charith Asalanka and Sri Lanka have found good momentum here.
Josh Inglis comes to the crease.

OUT LBW! Another one bites the dust and there are two new batters in space of two balls. Maheesh Theekshana bowls from 'round the wicket and angles a full ball, around middle and leg. Warner stays back and leans to defend but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW and nothing given from the umpire. Sri Lanka take the review. UltraEdge shows no bat there. David Warner is already walking back as Ball Tracking shows three reds. Out it is.
Steven Smith comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes! He gets rid of the dangerous, Glenn Maxwell! A wicket at a perfect time for Sri Lanka. Another googly, full in length, around middle and off. Glenn Maxwell dances down the track and smashes it towards long on. He does so without any elevation, that has been hit very flat, and Danushka Gunathilaka at long on pouches it safely. Australia have lost their second wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Danushka Gunathilaka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, around middle and leg. David Warner sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Beaten now! Lovely delivery! Another loopy ball, down the leg side, another wrong'un. David Warner makes room again, and looks to smash this on the leg side but he misses it.
Tosses it up, full, around the leg pole. David Warner makes room and looks to heave this but the ball goes off his inside edge and onto his boot.
A googly, shorter one, around off. Glenn Maxwell pushes it towards long off for a single.
Tosses it up, fuller one, around middle. David Warner knocks it to long on for a single.
Shorter again, around middle and leg. David Warner steps down the wicket and knocks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 14 runs off the over!

This is not great bowling from Praveen Jayawickrama! Another short ball, around the pads. David Warner pulls it towards deep sqaure leg. The fielder runs to his left, dives, and makes a good stop. Two taken!
FOUR! Another top shot! Praveen Jayawickrama drops it short, around middle and off. David Warner pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Australia are cruising along at the moment!
Good running! A fuller one, around middle and leg. David Warner looks to sweep this but the ball goes off his inside edge towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A full toss, around the leg pole. David Warner dances down the track and pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Praveen Jayawickrama tosses this one up, very full, around off. Glenn Maxwell drives it towards deep cover. Single taken!
Praveen Jayawickrama is brought into the attack.
Pitches it up again, around middle and leg. David Warner flicks it through square leg for a brace. 9 runs off Wanindu Hasaranga's first over!
Much fuller now, outside off, loopy one. David Warner drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Tad shorter, around middle and off. David Warner miscues his pull shot towards mid-wicket. No run there!
Quicker, fuller, around middle and leg. Glenn Maxwell flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller now, around off. Glenn Maxwell blocks it out.
SIX! BOOM! Glenn Maxwell greets Wanindu Hasaranga with a maximum! Poor ball to begin with though! A googly, too short, around middle. Glenn Maxwell pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Wanindu Hasaranga is into the attack.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Dasun Shanaka drops it short, around off. David Warner upper cuts it towards third man. The ball goes one bounce over the ropes for a boundary.
Yorker, around off. David Warner fails to squeeze it out.

In the air..and FOUR! That's a poor effort in the deep! A fuller ball, outside off. David Warner looks to go over cover but the ball goes off the splice and towards third man. Praveen Jayawickrama runs towards the ball, the ball bounces and he runs past the ball. He was probably undone by the spin there but a boundary for Australia!
Yorker-length delivery, wide of off, at 127 clicks. David Warner digs it towards point.
Angling in on a length, around middle and leg. Glenn Maxwell flicks it towards deep mid-wicker. Single taken!
Dasun Shanaka begins with a shortish ball, around off, slower in pace. David Warner pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for Australia!
Dasun Shanaka to bowl now.

SIX! BANG! Glenn Maxwell is off the mark in grand fashion! Another back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Glenn Maxwell pulls this over deep square leg for a biggie. First six of the innings! Australia are 49 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Shorter ball, turns away, around off. Glenn Maxwell pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Glenn Maxwell is the new batter in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! A much-needed wicket for Sri Lanka! Maheesh Theekshana draws first blood. Aaron Finch departs after yet another fine knock. Much slower this time, tosses it up, full and around off. Aaron Finch gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he misses as the ball spins in and knocks the off pole. Maheesh Theekshana punches the air in delight!
This one spins in, quicker, around middle and leg. Aaron Finch pushes it off the back foot wide of long on for a brace.
Another shorter ball, around middle and off. David Warner knocks it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Quicker, flatter, around off, that one keeps low as well. David Warner clears his front leg and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
A slower one at 116 kph and it completely deceives Aaron Finch! This is outside off. He fails to push it away.
Chameera targets his length and serves it very full. Warner turns it to mid-wicket for a run.
Slower one on middle, pushed to cover-point for another sharp single. Ohh...dear! A no ball is called as Chameera overstepped and a Free Hit will follow.
On a length and around off. Warner drops it to point and scampers for a quick single.

FOUR! Beats the fielder! Chameera drags his length back and around off. Warner pulls it to mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his right but fails to stop and the mid on fielder gives a chase but to no avail as the ball wins the race.
A single! Length and on off. Finch hits it to covers and calls for a quick single.
FOUR! Full length and it races away to the fence. This is around off. Finch stays back and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. It is either a four or a dot in the last few overs.
Great finish and the crowd backs with a huge roar for Chamika! Fuller and on middle. Warner tucks it to the left of the bowler who dives and stops it.
Four dots now! Good comeback after going for a boundary on the first ball! Length and outside off. Warner cuts it late to short third man.
Pitched up, on off. David drives it to the left of mid off.
Length and on top of off. Warner knocks it to covers.
That is the length Karunaratne should follow! On a length and, around the 5th stump channel at 131 clicks. Warner looks to push it but misses.
FOUR! A freebie for Warner and he dispatches it! An off-cutter from Chamika but he serves it too full and outside off. Warner bends his back knee and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Change of ends for Chamika Karunaratne!
Three dots to end the over! Still, 8 runs off it. Around off, fuller, pushed to covers.
Dot again! Maheesh Theekshana keeping it tight now! On middle. Finch keeps it out.
Much better from Maheesh! Tossed up, quicker and on middle and leg. Finch works it to covers.
FOUR! Four fours for Finch! Flatter and outside off. Finch punches off the back foot through cover-point and it races away into the fence.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is full and on middle. Finch makes room and goes inside-out over covers for a boundary. His third boundary already.
Tossed up, on off. Finch pushes it to covers.
First bowling change! Maheesh Theekshana comes into the attack.
Three runs taken! On a length and outside off. A back foot punch from Finch through covers and he bags three runs as the fielder from the ring gives a chase and saves a single.
FOUR! Straight as an arrow! Overpitched, on middle. Finch hangs back and shows full face of the bat to loft it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Touch fuller and on top of off. Finch drops it to covers.
Length ball, outside off, moving away. Finch has a feel for it but fails to connect.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings and it comes off the skipper's bat. This is full and outside off. Finch drives it through covers for a boundary.
A ripper from Chameera to start his proceedings! On a length and outside off at 140 clicks, not much movement there. Finch drives inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Who will bowl from the other end? Dushmantha Chameera it is!
Four singles on a trot and Australia are off to a positive start. Length and on middle, tucked to square leg with soft hands for a single.
A quick single! Fuller and outside off. Warner drives it hard to covers where the man makes a half-stop and the batters take a quick single.
Finch is off the mark as well but in a streaky way! This is on a length and outside off. Finch prods to push but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
Around off and on a length. Warner taps it to third man and gets off the mark with a single.
On a length and around off, this one nips back in slightly. Warner tucks it to mid-wicket.
Karunaratne starts with a full ball, around off. Warner leans across and punches it to mid off.
We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. Aaron Finch and David Warner will open the batting for Australia. Chamika Karunaratne will begin with the ball. Let's go!

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka first informs that there is one change in the team. He feels there might be some assistance for the spinners. Tells that they should bring up the good thing from both previous matches and play collectively.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia. He says that they will bat, it looks like a dry wicket, they want to put runs on the board and look to defend it. Adds that Sri Lanka did a fantastic job in the previous game, but having an extra batter at number 7 helped them win the game. Informs that they have one change. Mitchell Marsh is out with a niggle and Josh Inglis comes in.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold is near the pitch. He says it is a very different pitch, it's dry and it also looks rough. Spin to win is the formula. Adds that the captain winning the toss should bat first. Informs that 170 is the average score and a score anywhere near that should be a winning total.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Danushka Gunathilaka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Praveen Jayawickrama (In for Nuwan Thushara).

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Josh Inglis (In for Mitchell Marsh), Glenn Maxwell, Steven Smith, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Ashton Agar, Jhye Richardson, Kane Richardson, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and they will BAT first!

Sri Lanka on the other hand needs to step up with the bat. In both the games, we witnessed a batting collapse from the hosts. They do have a quality side but have not been able to click. Their bowling unit looks strong but if they had some more runs on the board the outcome could have been different in the second T20I. Sri Lanka will want to put their best foot forward and finish this series on a high. A victory in this game can give them some kind of confidence going into the ODI series as well. Will they be able to avoid a whitewash? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
